Definition: Whether primary laws, acts, or legal instruments exist that establish authority for cross-government data sharing and govern the data exchange system
Comments: Multiple relevant laws exist: Data Protection Act 2012; Right to Information Act 2019; Payment Systems and Services Act 2019; National Data Sharing Policy (not yet a formal Act but comprehensive). Ghana Government Enterprise Architecture Framework 2022. eGIF v2.0 under stakeholder review. National Data Governance Framework 2024 in development. Legislation for cross-government data sharing exists but consolidated interoperability law not yet enacted.

Definition: Extent to which provincial/state and local governments participate in the data exchange
Comments: Open Government Partnership action planning has been adopted by Ghana's subnational administrations including at municipal assembly level. Ghana.gov is used at the national level with some sub-national participation. However, the DIAL study notes a decentralized approach with fragmented initiatives across MDAs. Sub-national participation is partial rather than full.

Comments: GODI Secretariat (housed in NITA since 2010) promotes transparency and accountability; 315 catalogs from 22 agencies publicly available. Right to Information Act 2019 enacted. No dedicated public dashboard for data exchange operations but significant open data infrastructure.
